Layers.LocateSelectionHint.zh: 定位到已选；再次点击按层级顺序遍历全部选择（可跨组合）
Layers.LocateSelectionHint.en: Locate selection; click again to cycle through all selected layers in hierarchy order, across groups

Layers.EnterHint.zh: 双击文字重命名；双击图标或留白进入组合
Layers.EnterHint.en: Double-click text to rename; double-click the icon or blank space to enter

Layers.InstanceHint.zh: 双击文字重命名此实例；双击图标或留白编辑共享定义
Layers.InstanceHint.en: Double-click text to rename this instance; double-click the icon or blank space to edit its shared definition

Layers.LegacyOrder.zh: 保留旧图层顺序：成员可能与组外图层交错
Layers.LegacyOrder.en: Preserved legacy order: members may interleave with layers outside this group

Layers.CollectHint.zh: 收拢会将成员移至连续层级，可能改变与其他图层的遮挡关系。
Layers.CollectHint.en: Consolidating puts members in one consecutive block and may change overlaps with other layers.

Layers.TreeHelp.zh: 列表展示当前层级。再次点击已选名称或按 F2 改名；Ctrl／Shift 点击用于多选。双击图标或留白、点击行箭头或按 Enter 进入组合。路径栏区分父级、当前项和已展开的深层；返回上层保留原分支，进入其他分支替换深层记录；失效路径自动回到有效父级或根画布。点击当前项或省略入口打开带深度角标及模式切换的导航菜单；列表中的左方向键或 Backspace 返回一级。Esc 取消局部操作或关闭面板，保留编辑范围。拖动手柄排序，拖到组合中部移入，拖到面包屑移出；列表边缘可自动滚动。右键可批量显隐、锁定或移动到目标，作用于完整有效选择。跨层编组位于参与对象的最近共同父级。部分对象已在移动目标时会一起收拢到顶部；全部已在目标则不移动。移动后停留原位置，可通过“查看目标”前往。至少选中一个可编辑图层即可 Ctrl+G 编组，Ctrl+Shift+G 解组；移走或删除最后一个成员后自动解散空组合。存在选择时可用标题栏模式开关左侧的“定位到已选”，连续点击按层级顺序遍历全部选中图层（包括其他组合内的选择），必要时进入其父组，并保留全部选择。
Layers.TreeHelp.en: The list shows the current level. Click a selected name again or press F2 to rename; Ctrl/Shift-click selects. Double-click an icon or blank space, click the row arrow or press Enter to enter. The path distinguishes ancestors, the current entry and explored descendants. Going up retains the branch; entering another branch replaces its suffix. Invalid paths return to a valid parent or canvas root. Click the current entry or overflow to open navigation with depth badges and a mode switch. Left or Backspace in the list returns one level. Escape cancels a local action or closes the panel, retaining scope. Drag handles to reorder, groups to move inside, breadcrumbs to move out; list edges scroll automatically. The context menu applies batch visibility, locking and Move to to the complete eligible selection. Cross-level grouping uses its nearest common parent. Partially matching destinations gather the whole eligible selection at the top; all already there is a no-op. Move keeps the current scope; View target navigates explicitly. Ctrl+G groups at least one editable layer; Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups. Deleting or moving the last member dissolves empty groups. Locate selection appears before the title-bar mode switch when layers are selected; repeated clicks cycle through all selected layers in hierarchy order across groups, entering the parent group when needed and retaining the full selection.
